remarks:
Located in Marrano's Mission Hills patio home community where an easy living lifestyle is one of its best attributes! This well sought after Patio A design is a pristine (never lived in) home that Marrano built as a lovely model home which they filled with so many amenities over the basic plan!   
Featuring a charming kitchen with white cabinetry to the ceiling, a ceramic tile backsplash, quartz countertops, all open to the dining/living room combo with a tray ceiling. Hardwood floors throughout most of the home. A beautiful cozy fireplace with a ledgestone surround, and a light-filled sunroom with wainscoting that opens to a covered patio out back. Primary suite with a WIC and a primary bath with double sinks and a ceramic tile shower. First floor laundry. Warm neutral colors throughout the home, beautiful lighting and plumbing fixtures, custom window treatments and all appliances included. Additional landscaping added to the sides of the home, a spacious lot, and a lawn sprinkler system included. Snow removal and lawn care are included in the HOA.  If you are looking to downsize and relax this is where it's at!
